poses.caption: Hold a straight plank with both hands on the edges of the upward-facing flat Bosu platform
Bend elbows and lower the chest toward the platform, then press up

jobs.detail: BOSU BALL PUSH-UP, TWO phases. Same full-body three-quarter FRONT SIDE view head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT, BOTH hands on outer edges of a single INVERTED BOSU: flat rigid circular black platform faces UP, blue-gray HALF-DOME faces DOWN contacting FLOOR. It is a low hemisphere half-ball balance trainer, not a full ball or bench. Platform/dome fixed size and position each panel. Both hands shoulder width on outer platform rims, fingers secure around edge, wrists continuous, no floor hand. Feet hip width toes on floor behind, knees STRAIGHT. LEFT high plank elbows extended, straight line shoulders hips heels. RIGHT lower chest toward upward flat platform by bending elbows about90degrees, same straight body/legs, chest above platform not through it. Entire hemisphere platform/body/shoes/hands within panel white margins. Primary CHEST/PECTORALS only red as smoothly blurred diffuse patches on intact OPAQUE BLACK shirt over chest, NO fibers/radial lines/pectoral subdivisions on fabric. All other muscle fine detailed grayscale. Full opaque shirt front sides back, knee shorts full front sides back seat crotch. No labels/arrows.

Press up and draw the right knee toward the chest
After returning and repeating the push-up, draw the left knee toward the chest

jobs.detail: KNEE-TO-CHEST FLOOR PUSH-UP, THREE phases. Full body three-quarter side view head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT, HANDS flat on FLOOR MAT directly under shoulders throughout, NO BENCH or equipment. LEFT low push-up: elbows about90degrees torso straight low, both knees STRAIGHT with both toes mat. MIDDLE press arms straight high plank, draw RIGHT knee FORWARD under torso toward chest, RIGHT foot lifted, LEFT leg STRAIGHT behind with toes mat. RIGHT after next rep press up and draw LEFT knee FORWARD under torso toward chest, LEFT foot lifted, RIGHT leg STRAIGHT behind toes mat. Clearly swap the bent-leg hip origin: middle FAR/right thigh bends under body while NEAR/left leg extends back; final NEAR/left thigh bends under body while FAR/right extends back. Pelvis level, only one knee bends in each high plank, exactly2legs/2arms. Primary CHEST only red soft diffuse patches on intact OPAQUE black chest shirt, NO fibers/radial rays/pectoral divisions through cloth. Grayscale detailed exposed muscle fibers everywhere else, no red abs/legs. Full opaque black shirt and shorts wrap front sides back seat crotch, no cutaways. Whole figure/hands/shoes fit each panel white margins. No text.
jobs.prompt: Correct this original project three-panel knee-to-chest floor push-up. Keep LEFT low push-up and RIGHT high plank with NEAR/foreground LEFT knee bent under chest, FAR/right leg straight back toes floor. CHANGE MIDDLE to OPPOSITE leg: NEAR/foreground LEFT leg fully STRAIGHT extending from near hip back to toes on floor IMAGE RIGHT; FAR/right thigh bends FORWARD under torso to right knee near chest, right shin folded behind, right foot elevated. Trace separate hip origins carefully, exactly TWO legs, no overlapping duplicate knee. Hands stay floor under shoulders elbows straight in both high panels, pelvis level. No bench/equipment. Every panel: smooth diffuse BLURRED RED patches over intact opaque BLACK CHEST SHIRT only; erase all radial fiber/pectoral divisions from fabric. Full opaque shirt/shorts front sides back seat crotch. Preserve detailed fine grayscale fibers on all exposed arms/legs and exact model/camera. No text.
